// C++ の見本
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

namespace geo::detail {
template <typename T, std::size_t N = 3>
class Vec final : public Base<T> {
public:
    constexpr Vec() noexcept = default;
    explicit Vec(std::initializer_list<T> xs) : data_{} { std::copy(xs.begin(), xs.end(), data_); }
    [[nodiscard]] T operator[](std::size_t i) const { return data_[i]; }
    auto dot(const Vec& o) const -> T;
    virtual ~Vec() override = default;
private:
    T data_[N];
    static inline int count_ = 0;
};
}  // namespace geo::detail

template <class F, class... Args>
decltype(auto) call(F&& f, Args&&... args) { return std::forward<F>(f)(std::forward<Args>(args)...); }

enum class Mode : std::uint8_t { Fast = 1, Safe };
using Ptr = std::unique_ptr<int[]>;

int main() {
    auto lambda = [&, x = 1](int y) mutable -> int { return x += y; };
    std::vector<int> v{1, 2, 3};
    for (const auto& [i, x] : enumerate(v)) std::cout << i << ':' << x << '\n';
    auto s = R"(raw "string")"s;
    if constexpr (sizeof(void*) == 8) { static_assert(true, "64-bit"); }
    try { throw std::runtime_error{"boom"}; } catch (const std::exception& e) { std::cerr << e.what(); }
    co_return 0x1F'FF'FFull;
}
